articles.summary: NEW YORK, October 14, 2025/PRNewswire/ — SLR Capital Partners, LLC ("SLR"), a private credit platform operating in specialty finance direct lending to U.S. middle market companies, today announced that Mac Fowle has joined the firm as President of Asset-Based Lending ("ABL"). “In this newly created role, Fowle will lead the expansion of SLR's ABL platform by leveraging his more than 20 years of experience in the ABL industry for U.S. middle market...
articles.title: SLR Appoints Mac Fowle as President of ABL

articles.summary: NEW YORK , Oct. 01, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- SLR Investment Corp. (the “Company”) (NASDAQ: SLRC) today announced that it will release its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2025 on Tuesday, November 4, 2025 after the close of the financial markets.
articles.title: SLR Investment Corp. Schedules the Release of its Financial Results for the Quarter Ended September 30, 2025
